chunks.title: How to Connect Stripe Payment Gateway
chunks.heading: Connecting Stripe via Stripe Connect
chunks.text:
Document: How to Connect Stripe Payment Gateway
Category: Finance & Payments > Payment Gateways
Section: Connecting Stripe via Stripe Connect
Content:
To collect membership fees and recurring payments, navigate in your admin dashboard to Finance > Payment Gateways. Select Stripe from the list of supported processors and click 'Connect with Stripe'. You will be redirected to the secure Stripe authorization page. Log into your existing Stripe merchant account or register a new one. Grant permissions to Brilliant Directories to create charges and manage subscriptions. Once authorized, you will be returned to your admin dashboard where the status displays 'Connected (Live Mode)'.

Associated Visual Context:
[Visual Screenshot Note: Screenshot demonstrating How to Connect Stripe Payment Gateway configuration and settings in Brilliant Directories admin panel.]

chunks.title: How to Connect Stripe Payment Gateway
chunks.heading: Webhook and 3D Secure Configuration
chunks.text:
Document: How to Connect Stripe Payment Gateway
Category: Finance & Payments > Payment Gateways
Section: Webhook and 3D Secure Configuration
Content:
Brilliant Directories automatically provisions webhook listeners for customer.subscription.deleted, invoice.payment_succeeded, and charge.refunded events. 3D Secure (SCA - Strong Customer Authentication) is supported natively on checkout forms. Ensure that Test Mode is toggled OFF in Finance > Payment Gateways prior to launching public membership plans.

chunks.title: How to Customize Member Search Results & Filtering
chunks.heading: Configuring Search Result Layouts
chunks.text:
Document: How to Customize Member Search Results & Filtering
Category: Members & Listings > Search Settings
Section: Configuring Search Result Layouts
Content:
You can customize how members are displayed in directory searches by navigating to My Members > Search Results Settings. Under the 'Display View' dropdown, choose between List View, Grid View, or Map Split View. You can configure the number of members per page (default is 10, up to 50) and toggle whether member phone numbers and addresses are visible to non-logged-in visitors.

chunks.text:
Document: How to Customize Member Search Results & Filtering
Category: Members & Listings > Search Settings
Section: Enabling Sidebar Filters and Location Radius
Content:
To enable sidebar search filters, go to Settings > Design Settings > Search Results Pages. Enable 'Sidebar Search Filter Widget'. This allows users to filter members by Category, Sub-category, City, Postal Code, and Star Ratings. You can also define the default search radius (e.g., 25 miles or 50 km) using Google Maps API integration settings.

chunks.title: How to Process Member Refunds and Void Invoices
chunks.heading: Issuing a Refund in Transaction History
chunks.text:
Document: How to Process Member Refunds and Void Invoices
Category: Finance & Payments > Billing & Invoicing
Section: Issuing a Refund in Transaction History
Content:
To issue a refund to a member, navigate to Finance > Transaction History. Locate the specific transaction using the member name, email, or Transaction ID filter. Click the 'Actions' gear icon next to the payment and select 'Issue Refund'. You may enter a Full Refund or a Partial Refund amount. Check the box 'Notify Member via Email' to automatically send the refund confirmation email template.

Associated Visual Context:

chunks.title: How to Process Member Refunds and Void Invoices
chunks.heading: Canceling Subscriptions and Voiding Invoices
chunks.text:
Document: How to Process Member Refunds and Void Invoices
Category: Finance & Payments > Billing & Invoicing
Section: Canceling Subscriptions and Voiding Invoices
Content:
Refunding a transaction does not automatically cancel a recurring subscription. To stop future billings, navigate to My Members > Search Members, locate the member profile, click 'Edit Details', and set Membership Plan status to 'Cancelled' or 'Non-Renewing'. To void unpaid pending invoices, go to Finance > Invoices and click 'Void Invoice' from the dropdown actions menu.

Associated Visual Context:

chunks.heading: Creating Paid and Free Membership Tiers
chunks.text:
Document: Setting Up Membership Plans and Pricing Tiers
Category: Finance & Payments > Membership Plans
Section: Creating Paid and Free Membership Tiers
Content:
Navigate to Finance > Membership Plans. Click 'Add New Membership Plan'. Set the Plan Name (e.g., Free Basic, Premium Professional). Under the 'Pricing' tab, choose between Free, One-Time Payment, or Recurring Billing. For recurring plans, specify the billing cycle (Monthly, Quarterly, Semi-Annually, or Annually) and the recurring price. You can also define a Trial Period (e.g., 14 days free trial) and a Setup Fee.

chunks.title: Adding Custom CSS and Header Code to Your Site
chunks.heading: Inserting Custom CSS Styles
chunks.text:
Document: Adding Custom CSS and Header Code to Your Site
Category: Design & Customization > Custom Scripts
Section: Inserting Custom CSS Styles
Content:
To modify site styling without editing core theme widgets, go to Settings > Design Settings. Click on the 'Custom CSS / HEAD' tab. In the 'Additional CSS' textarea, input your custom CSS rules. These rules load after bootstrap and theme stylesheets, allowing you to override typography, button colors, and card layouts. Always click 'Save Changes' to recompile the stylesheet cache.

chunks.title: Configuring Webhooks and Developer API Services
chunks.heading: Setting Up Outgoing Webhooks
chunks.text:
Document: Configuring Webhooks and Developer API Services
Category: Developer Tools > API & Integrations
Section: Setting Up Outgoing Webhooks
Content:
Brilliant Directories allows real-time data export via Webhooks to Zapier, Make, or custom REST APIs. Navigate to Developer Hub > API Services > Webhook Endpoints. Click 'Add Webhook'. Select the trigger event: 'Member Signup', 'Member Profile Updated', 'Lead Submitted', or 'Payment Completed'. Enter your destination URL and authorization header token.

Associated Visual Context:

chunks.title: Configuring Webhooks and Developer API Services
chunks.heading: Using the REST API for Member Management
chunks.text:
Document: Configuring Webhooks and Developer API Services
Category: Developer Tools > API & Integrations
Section: Using the REST API for Member Management
Content:
The Brilliant Directories API supports GET, POST, PUT, and DELETE operations for members, coupons, and posts. Generate an API Key under Developer Hub > API Keys. Send the key in the request header as `X-Api-Key: {your_key}`. Rate limits are 120 requests per minute per domain.

chunks.title: Enabling Google reCAPTCHA v2 and v3 for Spam Protection
chunks.heading: Activating reCAPTCHA Keys
chunks.text:
Document: Enabling Google reCAPTCHA v2 and v3 for Spam Protection
Category: Settings & Security > Security & Spam
Section: Activating reCAPTCHA Keys
Content:
To protect registration and contact forms from automated bot submissions, go to Settings > General Settings > Integrations. Scroll down to Google reCAPTCHA. Enter your Google reCAPTCHA Site Key and Secret Key. Select between reCAPTCHA v2 ('I am not a robot' checkbox) or reCAPTCHA v3 (invisible score-based protection). Check the forms you want protected: Member Signup, Contact Us, Lead Form, and Review Submission. Click Save Changes.

Associated Visual Context:
[Visual Screenshot Note: Screenshot demonstrating Enabling Google reCAPTCHA v2 and v3 for Spam Protection configuration and settings in Brilliant Directories admin panel.]

Check the forms you want protected: Member Signup, Contact Us, Lead Form, and Review Submission. Click Save Changes.

chunks.title: Expert Answer: Can we integrate custom Solana cryptocurrency payments?
chunks.heading: Authoritative Expert Solution
chunks.text:
Document: Expert Resolution ESC-20261019-9EAECF
Question Asked: Can we integrate custom Solana cryptocurrency payments?
Verified Expert Solution (Lead Architect John):
Solana is not natively supported by Brilliant Directories. To accept SOL, you must use our Webhook Service (Developer Hub > API Services) to ping a custom middleware like Helio or Solana Pay, then credit the member profile via REST API PUT /members/{id}.
Additional Policy / Operational Notes:
Requires external server.
